The '''PVC-800''' was a personal vehicle coordinator manufactured by [[Vewas Data Controllers]]. It could take control of vehicles to prevent a collision, and provide data readouts projected on the windshield, which included listing whether [[Autopilot/Legends|auto mode]] was on, the current speed of the vehicle, the current coordinates, the amount of fuel, and the degrees of efficiency, as well as a [[Map/Legends|map]].
